metadata.name: Volcanic Hazard Zones
metadata.description: Volcanic arc and risk zone polygons. Pacific Ring of Fire derived from PB2002 Pacific Plate boundaries buffered ~220km. Additional arcs are bounding polygons from geological literature.
sources: Ring of Fire: PB2002 tectonic plate boundaries (Bird 2003) via fraxen/tectonicplates
Volcanic arcs: Bounding polygons from geological literature (USGS, Smithsonian GVP)
metadata.license: ODbL (Ring of Fire from PB2002); CC0 (arc bounding polygons)

properties.name: Pacific Ring of Fire
properties.description: Circum-Pacific volcanic belt - the most volcanically active region on Earth, containing ~75% of Earth's active volcanoes. Generated by buffering Pacific Plate boundaries by ~220km (2 degrees).
properties.source: Derived from PB2002 Pacific Plate boundaries (Bird 2003), buffered 2 degrees

properties.name: Andean Volcanic Arc
properties.description: Volcanic arc along western South America, from Colombia to Chile. Subduction of Nazca Plate.

properties.name: Cascade Volcanic Arc
properties.description: Pacific Northwest volcanic arc from N. California to British Columbia. Subduction of Juan de Fuca Plate.

properties.name: Kamchatka-Kuril Arc
properties.description: Volcanic arc along Kamchatka Peninsula and Kuril Islands. One of the most active volcanic regions.

properties.name: Japanese Volcanic Arc
properties.description: Volcanic arc of the Japanese islands. Subduction of Pacific and Philippine Sea Plates.

properties.name: Indonesian Volcanic Arc
properties.description: Volcanic arc of the Indonesian archipelago. Subduction of Indo-Australian Plate.

properties.name: Aleutian Volcanic Arc
properties.description: Volcanic arc along Aleutian Islands, Alaska. Subduction of Pacific Plate.

properties.name: Central American Volcanic Arc
properties.description: Volcanic arc along Pacific coast of Central America. Subduction of Cocos Plate.

properties.name: Mediterranean Volcanic Arc
properties.description: Volcanic arc in Mediterranean region (Italy, Greece, Turkey). African-Eurasian plate interaction.

properties.name: East African Rift Volcanic Zone
properties.description: Volcanic zone along East African Rift. Divergent plate boundary volcanism.

properties.name: Iceland Volcanic Zone
properties.description: Volcanic zone at Mid-Atlantic Ridge above sea level. Divergent boundary.
